verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יָכֹ֨ל יוֹסֵ֜ף לְהִתְאַפֵּ֗ק לְכֹ֤ל הַנִּצָּבִים֙ עָלָ֔יו וַיִּקְרָ֕א הוֹצִ֥יאוּ כָל־ אִ֖ישׁ מֵעָלָ֑י וְלֹא־ עָ֤מַד אִישׁ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ בְּהִתְוַדַּ֥ע יוֹסֵ֖ף אֶל־ אֶחָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḵōl yō·w·sêp̄ lə·hiṯ·’ap·pêq lə·ḵōl han·niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm ‘ā·lāw way·yiq·rā hō·w·ṣî·’ū ḵāl ’îš mê·‘ā·lāy wə·lō- ‘ā·maḏ ’îš ’it·tōw bə·hiṯ·wad·da‘ yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- ’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants and he cried out Send everyone . . . away from me So none of them were with . . . Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO José não se podia conter diante de todos os que estavam com ele; e clamou: Fazei sair daqui a todo o homem; e ninguém ficou com ele, quando José se deu a conhecer a seus irmãos.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֶת־ קֹל֖וֹ בִּבְכִ֑י וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע בֵּ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’eṯ- qō·lōw biḇ·ḵî way·yiš·mə·‘ū miṣ·ra·yim way·yiš·ma‘ bêṯ par·‘ōh
verses.literal: But he wept so loudly - that the Egyptians heard him and Pharaoh’s household soon heard of it
verses.literalPt: E levantou a sua voz com choro, de maneira que os egípcios o ouviam, e a casa de Faraó o ouviu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶל־ אֶחָיו֙ אֲנִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף הַע֥וֹד אָבִ֖י חָ֑י וְלֹֽא־ יָכְל֤וּ אֶחָיו֙ לַעֲנ֣וֹת אֹת֔וֹ כִּ֥י נִבְהֲל֖וּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- ’e·ḥāw ’ă·nî yō·w·sêp̄ ha·‘ō·wḏ ’ā·ḇî ḥāy wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lū ’e·ḥāw la·‘ă·nō·wṯ ’ō·ṯōw kî niḇ·hă·lū mip·pā·nāw
verses.literal: Joseph said to his brothers I am Joseph Is my father still alive But they were unable . . . to answer him because they were terrified in his presence
verses.literalPt: E disse José a seus irmãos: Eu sou José; vive ainda meu pai? E seus irmãos não lhe puderam responder, porque estavam pasmados diante da sua face.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶל־ אֶחָ֛יו גְּשׁוּ־ נָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וַיִּגָּ֑שׁוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֲנִי֙ יוֹסֵ֣ף אֲחִיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖י מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- ’e·ḥāw gə·šū- nā ’ê·lay way·yig·gā·šū way·yō·mer ’ă·nî yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·ḥî·ḵem ’ă·šer- mə·ḵar·tem ’ō·ṯî miṣ·rā·yə·māh
verses.literal: Then Joseph said to his brothers Please . . . come near me And they did so I am Joseph your brother he said the one you sold into Egypt
verses.literalPt: E disse José a seus irmãos: Peço-vos, chegai-vos a mim. E chegaram-se; então disse ele: Eu sou José vosso irmão, a quem vendestes para o Egito.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ אַל־ תֵּעָ֣צְב֗וּ וְאַל־ יִ֙חַר֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖י הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֣י לְמִֽחְיָ֔ה שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tê·‘ā·ṣə·ḇū wə·’al- yi·ḥar bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem kî- mə·ḵar·tem ’ō·ṯî hên·nāh kî lə·miḥ·yāh šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm lip̄·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: And now do not be distressed . . . or angry with yourselves that you sold me into this place because it was to save lives that God sent me before you
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, não vos entristeçais, nem vos pese aos vossos olhos por me haverdes vendido para cá; porque para conservação da vida, Deus me enviou adiante de vós.

verses.original: כִּי־ זֶ֛ה שְׁנָתַ֥יִם הָרָעָ֖ב בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעוֹד֙ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין־ חָרִ֖ישׁ וְקָצִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- zeh šə·nā·ṯa·yim hā·rā·‘āḇ bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘ō·wḏ ḥā·mêš šā·nîm ’ă·šer ’ên- ḥā·rîš wə·qå̄ṣ·ṣīr
verses.literal: For the famine has covered the land these two years and there will be five more years without plowing or harvesting
verses.literalPt: Porque já houve dois anos de fome no meio da terra, e ainda restam cinco anos em que não haverá lavoura nem sega.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם לָשׂ֥וּם לָכֶ֛ם שְׁאֵרִ֖ית בָּאָ֑רֶץ וּלְהַחֲי֣וֹת לָכֶ֔ם לִפְלֵיטָ֖ה גְּדֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lā·ḥê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm lip̄·nê·ḵem lā·śūm lā·ḵem šə·’ê·rîṯ bā·’ā·reṣ ū·lə·ha·ḥă·yō·wṯ lā·ḵem lip̄·lê·ṭāh gə·ḏō·lāh
verses.literal: God sent me before you to preserve you as a remnant on the earth and to save your lives . . . by a great deliverance
verses.literalPt: Pelo que Deus me enviou adiante de vós, para conservar vossa sucessão na terra, e para guardar-vos em vida por um grande livramento.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה לֹֽא־ אַתֶּ֞ם שְׁלַחְתֶּ֤ם אֹתִי֙ הֵ֔נָּה כִּ֖י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיְשִׂימֵ֨נִֽי לְאָ֜ב לְפַרְעֹ֗ה וּלְאָדוֹן֙ לְכָל־ בֵּית֔וֹ וּמֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lō- ’at·tem šə·laḥ·tem ’ō·ṯî hên·nāh kî hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·śî·mê·nî lə·’āḇ lə·p̄ar·‘ōh ū·lə·’ā·ḏō·wn lə·ḵāl bê·ṯōw ū·mō·šêl bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Therefore it was not you who sent me here but God who has made me a father to Pharaoh lord of all his household and ruler over all the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Assim não fostes vós que me enviastes para cá, senão Deus, que me tem posto por pai de Faraó, e por senhor de toda a sua casa, e como regente em toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: מַהֲרוּ֮ וַעֲל֣וּ אֶל־ אָבִי֒ וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ בִּנְךָ֣ יוֹסֵ֔ף שָׂמַ֧נִי אֱלֹהִ֛ים לְאָד֖וֹן לְכָל־ מִצְרָ֑יִם רְדָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י אַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ma·hă·rū wa·‘ă·lū ’el- ’ā·ḇî wa·’ă·mar·tem ’ê·lāw kōh ’ā·mar bin·ḵā yō·w·sêp̄ śā·ma·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·’ā·ḏō·wn lə·ḵāl miṣ·rā·yim rə·ḏāh ’ê·lay ’al- ta·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: Now return quickly to my father and tell him This is what your son Joseph says God has made me lord of all Egypt Come down to me without delay
verses.literalPt: Apressai-vos, e subi a meu pai, e dizei-lhe: Assim tem dito o teu filho José: Deus me tem posto por senhor em toda a terra do Egito; desce a mim, e não te demores;

verses.original: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֣ בְאֶֽרֶץ־ גֹּ֗שֶׁן וְהָיִ֤יתָ קָרוֹב֙ אֵלַ֔י אַתָּ֕ה וּבָנֶ֖יךָ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנֶ֑יךָ וְצֹאנְךָ֥ וּבְקָרְךָ֖ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šaḇ·tā ḇə·’e·reṣ- gō·šen wə·hā·yî·ṯā qā·rō·wḇ ’ê·lay ’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nê ḇā·ne·ḵā wə·ṣō·nə·ḵā ū·ḇə·qā·rə·ḵā wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lāḵ
verses.literal: You shall settle in the land of Goshen and be near me . . . you and your children and grandchildren . . . your flocks and herds and everything you own
verses.literalPt: E habitarás na terra de Gósen, e estarás perto de mim, tu e os teus filhos, e os filhos dos teus filhos, e as tuas ovelhas, e as tuas vacas, e tudo o que tens.

verses.original: וְכִלְכַּלְתִּ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ שָׁ֔ם כִּי־ ע֛וֹד חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים רָעָ֑ב פֶּן־ תִּוָּרֵ֛שׁ אַתָּ֥ה וּבֵֽיתְךָ֖ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵil·kal·tî ’ō·ṯə·ḵā šām kî- ‘ō·wḏ ḥā·mêš šā·nîm rā·‘āḇ pen- tiw·wā·rêš ’at·tāh ū·ḇê·ṯə·ḵā wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lāḵ
verses.literal: And there I will provide for you because there will be five more years of famine Otherwise you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution
verses.literalPt: E ali te sustentarei, porque ainda haverá cinco anos de fome, para que não pereças de pobreza, tu e tua casa, e tudo o que tens.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֤ה עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ רֹא֔וֹת וְעֵינֵ֖י אָחִ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ין כִּי־ פִ֖י הַֽמְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ‘ê·nê·ḵem rō·’ō·wṯ wə·‘ê·nê ’ā·ḥî ḇin·yā·mîn kî- p̄î ham·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Behold You and my brother Benjamin can see that I, Joseph, am the one speaking with you
verses.literalPt: E eis que vossos olhos, e os olhos de meu irmão Benjamim, vêem que é minha boca que vos fala.

verses.original: וְהִגַּדְתֶּ֣ם לְאָבִ֗י אֶת־ כָּל־ כְּבוֹדִי֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֑ם וּמִֽהַרְתֶּ֛ם וְהוֹרַדְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ אָבִ֖י הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hig·gaḏ·tem lə·’ā·ḇî ’eṯ- kāl- kə·ḇō·w·ḏî bə·miṣ·ra·yim wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer rə·’î·ṯem ū·mi·har·tem wə·hō·w·raḏ·tem ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî hên·nāh
verses.literal: Tell my father about all my splendor in Egypt and everything you have seen And bring my father down here quickly
verses.literalPt: E fazei saber a meu pai toda a minha glória no Egito, e tudo o que tendes visto, e apressai-vos a fazer descer meu pai para cá.

verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֛ל עַל־ צַוְּארֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן־ אָחִ֖יו וַיֵּ֑בְךְּ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן בָּכָ֖ה עַל־ צַוָּארָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip·pōl ‘al- ṣaw·wə·rê ḇin·yā·min- ’ā·ḥîw way·yê·ḇək ū·ḇin·yā·min bā·ḵāh ‘al- ṣaw·wā·rāw
verses.literal: Then Joseph threw his arms around . . . . . . his brother Benjamin and wept and Benjamin wept as they embraced
verses.literalPt: E lançou-se ao pescoço de Benjamim seu irmão, e chorou; e Benjamim chorou também ao seu pescoço.

verses.original: וַיְנַשֵּׁ֥ק לְכָל־ אֶחָ֖יו וַיֵּ֣בְךְּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאַ֣חֲרֵי כֵ֔ן דִּבְּר֥וּ אֶחָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·naš·šêq lə·ḵāl ’e·ḥāw way·yê·ḇək ‘ă·lê·hem wə·’a·ḥă·rê ḵên dib·bə·rū ’e·ḥāw ’it·tōw
verses.literal: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them And afterward . . . his brothers talked with him
verses.literalPt: E beijou a todos os seus irmãos, e chorou sobre eles; e depois seus irmãos falaram com ele.

verses.original: וְהַקֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמַ֗ע בֵּ֤ית פַּרְעֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּ֖אוּ אֲחֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיִּיטַב֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וּבְעֵינֵ֖י עֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·qōl niš·ma‘ bêṯ par·‘ōh lê·mōr bā·’ū ’ă·ḥê yō·w·sêp̄ way·yî·ṭaḇ bə·‘ê·nê p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw
verses.literal: When the news reached Pharaoh’s . . . house that Joseph’s brothers had come Pharaoh . . . and his servants were pleased . . .
verses.literalPt: E esta notícia ouviu-se na casa de Faraó: Os irmãos de José são vindos; e pareceu bem aos olhos de Faraó, e aos olhos de seus servos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־ אַחֶ֖יךָ זֹ֣את עֲשׂ֑וּ טַֽעֲנוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּעִ֣ירְכֶ֔ם וּלְכוּ־ בֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ’a·ḥe·ḵā zōṯ ‘ă·śū ṭa·‘ă·nū ’eṯ- bə·‘î·rə·ḵem ū·lə·ḵū- ḇō·’ū ’ar·ṣāh kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: Pharaoh said to Joseph Tell . . . your brothers Do as follows Load your animals and return . . . to the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: E disse Faraó a José: Dize a teus irmãos: Fazei isto: carregai os vossos animais e parti, tornai à terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וּקְח֧וּ אֶת־ אֲבִיכֶ֛ם וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּיכֶ֖ם וּבֹ֣אוּ אֵלָ֑י וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה לָכֶ֗ם אֶת־ טוּב֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְאִכְל֖וּ אֶת־ חֵ֥לֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·qə·ḥū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·ḵem wə·’eṯ- bāt·tê·ḵem ū·ḇō·’ū ’ê·lāy wə·’et·tə·nāh lā·ḵem ’eṯ- ṭūḇ ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim wə·’iḵ·lū ’eṯ- ḥê·leḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then bring your father and your families and return to me I will give you the best of the land of Egypt and you shall eat from the fat of the land
verses.literalPt: E tornai a vosso pai, e às vossas famílias, e vinde a mim; e eu vos darei o melhor da terra do Egito, e comereis da fartura da terra.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֥ה צֻוֵּ֖יתָה זֹ֣את עֲשׂ֑וּ קְחוּ־ לָכֶם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם עֲגָל֗וֹת לְטַפְּכֶם֙ וְלִנְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם וּנְשָׂאתֶ֥ם אֶת־ אֲבִיכֶ֖ם וּבָאתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ṣuw·wê·ṯāh zōṯ ‘ă·śū qə·ḥū- lā·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ‘ă·ḡā·lō·wṯ lə·ṭap·pə·ḵem wə·lin·šê·ḵem ū·nə·śā·ṯem ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·ḵem ū·ḇā·ṯem
verses.literal: You are also directed to tell them . . . . . . Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your young children and your wives and bring your father and come back
verses.literalPt: A ti, pois, é ordenado: Fazei isto: tomai vós da terra do Egito carros para vossos meninos, para vossas mulheres, e para vosso pai, e vinde.

verses.original: וְעֵ֣ינְכֶ֔ם אַל־ תָּחֹ֖ס עַל־ כְּלֵיכֶ֑ם כִּי־ ט֛וּב כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָכֶ֥ם הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·nə·ḵem ’al- tā·ḥōs ‘al- kə·lê·ḵem kî- ṭūḇ kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lā·ḵem hū
verses.literal: But pay no regard . . . to your belongings for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours
verses.literalPt: E não vos pese coisa alguma dos vossos utensílios; porque o melhor de toda a terra do Egito será vosso.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֥ם יוֹסֵ֛ף עֲגָל֖וֹת עַל־ פִּ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֛ם צֵדָ֖ה לַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yit·tên lā·hem yō·w·sêp̄ ‘ă·ḡā·lō·wṯ ‘al- pî p̄ar·‘ōh way·yit·tên lā·hem ṣê·ḏāh lad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: So the sons of Israel did as they were told Joseph gave them wagons as Pharaoh had instructed and he also gave them provisions for their journey
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Israel fizeram assim. E José deu-lhes carros, conforme o mandado de Faraó; também lhes deu comida para o caminho.

verses.original: לְכֻלָּ֥ם נָתַ֛ן לָאִ֖ישׁ חֲלִפ֣וֹת שְׂמָלֹ֑ת וּלְבִנְיָמִ֤ן נָתַן֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְחָמֵ֖שׁ חֲלִפֹ֥ת שְׂמָלֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵul·lām nā·ṯan lā·’îš ḥă·li·p̄ō·wṯ śə·mā·lōṯ ū·lə·ḇin·yā·min nā·ṯan šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ke·sep̄ wə·ḥā·mêš ḥă·li·p̄ōṯ śə·mā·lōṯ
verses.literal: He gave new garments to each of them but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes
verses.literalPt: A todos lhes deu, a cada um, mudas de roupas; mas a Benjamim deu trezentas peças de prata, e cinco mudas de roupas.

verses.original: וּלְאָבִ֞יו שָׁלַ֤ח כְּזֹאת֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה חֲמֹרִ֔ים נֹשְׂאִ֖ים מִטּ֣וּב מִצְרָ֑יִם וְעֶ֣שֶׂר אֲתֹנֹ֡ת נֹֽ֠שְׂאֹת בָּ֣ר וָלֶ֧חֶם וּמָז֛וֹן לְאָבִ֖יו לַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’ā·ḇîw šā·laḥ kə·zōṯ ‘ă·śā·rāh ḥă·mō·rîm nō·śə·’îm miṭ·ṭūḇ miṣ·rā·yim wə·‘e·śer ’ă·ṯō·nōṯ nō·śə·’ōṯ bār wā·le·ḥem ū·mā·zō·wn lə·’ā·ḇîw lad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: And he sent to his father the following ten donkeys loaded with the best of Egypt and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provisions for his father’s journey
verses.literalPt: E a seu pai enviou semelhantemente dez jumentos carregados do melhor do Egito, e dez jumentos carregados de trigo e pão, e comida para seu pai, para o caminho.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ אֶחָ֖יו וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַֽל־ תִּרְגְּז֖וּ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw way·yê·lê·ḵū way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’al- tir·gə·zū bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Then Joseph sent his brothers on their way and as they were leaving he said to them Do not quarrel on the way
verses.literalPt: E despediu os seus irmãos, e partiram; e disse-lhes: Não contendais pelo caminho.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲבִיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū mim·miṣ·rā·yim way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·ḇî·hem
verses.literal: So the brothers went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: E subiram do Egito, e vieram à terra de Canaã, a Jacó seu pai.

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֨דוּ ל֜וֹ לֵאמֹ֗ר ע֚וֹד יוֹסֵ֣ף חַ֔י וְכִֽי־ ה֥וּא מֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיָּ֣פָג לִבּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י לֹא־ הֶאֱמִ֖ין לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gi·ḏū lōw lê·mōr ‘ō·wḏ yō·w·sêp̄ ḥay wə·ḵî- hū mō·šêl bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim way·yā·p̄āḡ lib·bōw kî lō- he·’ĕ·mîn lā·hem
verses.literal: Joseph is still alive they said and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt But Jacob was stunned . . . for he did not believe them
verses.literalPt: Então lhe anunciaram, dizendo: José ainda vive, e ele também é regente em toda a terra do Egito. E o seu coração desmaiou, porque não os acreditava.

verses.original: וַיְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו אֵ֣ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ הָ֣עֲגָל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח יוֹסֵ֖ף לָשֵׂ֣את אֹת֑וֹ וַתְּחִ֕י ר֖וּחַ יַעֲקֹ֥ב אֲבִיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bə·rū ’ê·lāw ’êṯ kāl- diḇ·rê yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·šer dib·ber ’ă·lê·hem way·yar ’eṯ- hā·‘ă·ḡā·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ yō·w·sêp̄ lā·śêṯ ’ō·ṯōw wat·tə·ḥî rū·aḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·ḇî·hem
verses.literal: However, when they relayed all . . . that Joseph had told them and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him back the spirit of their father Jacob was revived
verses.literalPt: Porém, havendo-lhe eles contado todas as palavras de José, que ele lhes falara, e vendo ele os carros que José enviara para levá-lo, reviveu o espírito de Jacó seu pai.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רַ֛ב עוֹד־ יוֹסֵ֥ף בְּנִ֖י חָ֑י אֵֽלְכָ֥ה וְאֶרְאֶ֖נּוּ בְּטֶ֥רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yiś·rā·’êl raḇ ‘ō·wḏ- yō·w·sêp̄ bə·nî ḥāy ’ê·lə·ḵāh wə·’er·’en·nū bə·ṭe·rem ’ā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Enough declared Israel My son Joseph is still alive I will go to see him before I die
verses.literalPt: E disse Israel: Basta; ainda vive meu filho José; eu irei e o verei antes que morra.
